preregistration: HELD-OUT set. Authored 2026-10-11 BEFORE any code change of the 2026-10-11 pass and BEFORE any run of any condition on these personas; its hash is frozen in FROZEN.sha256 before the first (baseline) run. The v1/v2 Lift sets were inspected question by question while diagnosing the World Model and are DEV data from this pass on; this set is the one the pass is judged on. Author independence is NOT met (written by the engineer who tunes the system; disclosed). Histories are multi-session (each session is ingested as its own conversation) and each persona uploads one document through the production upload path. Histories, questions and rubrics must not be edited to change a result; a labelling error may be corrected only with a dated entry in `corrections`, and every earlier result must be re-run.

rubricSemantics.required: Each item must be stated or clearly used by the answer. Paraphrase counts; a hedge that still commits to the fact counts.
rubricSemantics.forbidden: Each item is VIOLATED if the answer asserts it as currently true. Mentioning it as past, superseded or corrected is NOT a violation.
rubricSemantics.expectUnknown: The user never stated this. A correct answer says it does not know (and may ask once). Asserting a specific value is fabrication.
